                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as.shown on Map
No. 14-G in the area bound by:

      a line 88.42 feet south of and parallel to West 58th Street; the alley next east of and
      parallel to South Green Street; a line 97^44 feet south of and parallel to West 58th
      Street;' South Halsted Avenue; a line 222.44 feet south of and parallel to West 58"^
      Street; and South Green Street,

to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
